{{Quote|Republic species databanks express Ugnaughts as porcine-bipeds. Relevant descriptors are small, tusks, and unfriendly.|The [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] droid [[Hib-R-ak]] describes Ugnaughts to a spacer|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ugnaughts''' were [[Porcine/Legends|porcine]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with slightly upturned noses from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]]. Compared to baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]], their height would be considered short or dwarfed. Ugnaughts were industrious and loyal workers with a rich oral tradition. They were quite hardy, able to withstand long periods of discomfort, and lived around two hundred years.

==Society==
[[File:Ugnaughts-TESB30.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Ugnaughts on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]]]

Ugnaughts were ruled by elected ''terend'' councils, which were led by elected ''ufflor'' officers. They were also represented in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Parliament of Guilds]]. Ugnaughts lived in accordance with their "blood profession," with Ugnaught parents teaching their children their trade. Infant Ugnaughts were known as ''Ugletts''. If the number of new Ugnaughts in a given profession exceeded the number needed, a ''blood duel'' was called. When the Ugnaughts reached their twentieth year of age, these fights were held to the death, with the victor winning the right to inherit their blood profession. Despite this outdated and violent custom, the Ugnaughts were generally a peaceful people with a rich culture.

When greeting an Ugnaught, it was advised to bow silently, then wait for a guttural purring as a positive response. Usage of the common galactic greeting "yaa-yaah" was considered a personal insult to Ugnaughts. If this occurred, it was advisable to duck and cover, as various mechanical implements would be thrown one's way.<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Alza'ran was a common name among Ugnaughts.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|These creatures have little fight in them. They will make excellent slaves.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="GG2">[[General Grievous 2|''General Grievous'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:BattleofGentes2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gentes's population taken prisoner after the [[Battle of Gentes]]]]

Originally from the planet [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] in the remote [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], Ugnaughts were taken away from their homeworld as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] long before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era. Entire tribes would often be sold into slavery. The remaining Ugnaughts lived on the planet's less-than-hospitable surface.

When the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] eccentric and noble Lord [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] wished to build a floating mining complex on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], he decided to recruit several Ugnaught tribes to help in the mining of the base metals needed to build the structure. He bought the services of three Ugnaught tribes: the [[Botrut]], the [[Isced]], and the [[Irden]].

He promised them freedom, livelihood and a share in the [[Figg & Associates]] profits. Once [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was built, the noble Ecclessis Figg remembered his promise and gave them their freedom. To make themselves feel at home, the Ugnaughts constructed many labyrinthine and humid red-lit tunnels throughout the city, most of which could only be navigated by their kind.<ref name="SWCE" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], some Ugnaughts worked at the [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] maximum-security prison. When the facility was infiltrated by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], he encountered these Ugnaughts while escaping the facility.<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led an [[Battle of Gentes|invasion]] of Gentes.<ref name="GG2" /> His forces destroyed the Ugnaught Administration Hub and disabled the planet's defenses. He then took the entire Ugnaught population prisoner and put them to work in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] droid foundries on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Later he massacred the remaining Ugnaughts, except for some survivors who were later killed by General Grievous, when attempting to rescue a group of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. A shipment of these Ugnaught slaves was rescued by the Jedi [[Treetower]] and the [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad|H.O.P.E. Squad]] on [[Yorn Skot]].

[[File:Ugnaught_Worker_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An Ugnaught worker]]

Under the [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human-centric]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Ugnaught slavery continued, and they were used for many Imperial projects.

Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] mining colony fell under the rule of Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hugo Treece]], who enslaved the Ugnaughts. Many Ugnaughts fled the city, led by the wealthy [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]] who sheltered the refugees on floating platforms terraformed to mimic the original Ugnaught home world. There, King Ozz's Ugnaughts formed a resistance movement on Bespin, which planted bombs throughout the colony. As a result, Cloud City was evacuated until the bombs could be defused. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] recaptured Bespin, the Ugnaughts returned. The fall of the Empire meant that things would return to normal for the Ugnaughts.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]] indicates that [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] was the home planet of the Ugnaughts. Later sources changed their homeworld to Gentes.
